description:
club Annual picnic to Grape County Nashik 2nd October to 4th October
What a fantastic and unforgettable picnic at Grape County, Nashik. The energy, enthusiasm, and warm bonding from every single one of you made these three days truly memorable. A heartfelt thank you to each member and spouse for coming together and making this retreat such a resounding success.
While we celebrated, we deeply missed Rajesh Lath & Madhu, and Kalpana & Ramesh Thakkar, who could not join us due to sudden illness. We send them our fondest thoughts and wish them a very speedy recovery and continued good health.
An event of this scale succeeds only when a dedicated team works tirelessly behind the scenes. My deepest gratitude goes out to:
Digant – For acting as our master troubleshooter. From managing finances and liaising with the resort to handling member outreach, sorting out transportation, and arranging carpooling, your tremendous effort kept everything running seamlessly.
